title: Adonijah Sets Himself Up as King

questions.question: Who exalted himself saying, "I will be king," when David was old?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:5 (ESV): "Now Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, 'I will be king.' And he prepared for himself chariots and horsemen..."

questions.question: Who went to King David to inform him of Adonijah's actions?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:15-16 (ESV): "So Bathsheba went to the king into his chamber... And Bathsheba bowed and paid homage to the king..."

questions.question: Which prophet helped Bathsheba secure Solomon's throne?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:11 (ESV): "Then Nathan said to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, 'Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has become king... Try to save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.'"

questions.question: Who did David command to anoint Solomon as king?
options: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet
questions.correctAnswer: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:34 (ESV): "And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet there anoint him king over Israel. Then blow the trumpet and say, 'Long live King Solomon!'"

questions.question: Where did Adonijah go seeking safety when he heard Solomon was king?
options: To the horns of the altar
questions.correctAnswer: To the horns of the altar
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:50 (ESV): "And Adonijah feared Solomon. So he arose and went and took hold of the horns of the altar."

questions.question: Who attended on King David in his old age to keep him warm?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:3 (ESV): "So they sought for a beautiful young woman throughout all the territory of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king."

questions.question: Which military commander supported Adonijah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:7 (ESV): "He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest. And they followed Adonijah and helped him."

questions.question: Which priest supported Adonijah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:7 (ESV): "He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest..."

questions.question: Where was Solomon anointed?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:33 (ESV): "...cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon."

questions.question: Who brought the news to Adonijah's feast that Solomon was king?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:42 (ESV): "While he was still speaking, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came."

questions.question: Who did NOT join Adonijah's conspiracy?
options: Nathan, Benaiah, and the mighty men
questions.correctAnswer: Nathan, Benaiah, and the mighty men
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:8 (ESV): "But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and David's mighty men were not with Adonijah."

questions.question: What did Adonijah sacrifice at the Serpent's Stone?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:9 (ESV): "Adonijah sacrificed sheep, oxen, and fattened cattle by the Serpent's Stone, which is beside En-rogel..."

questions.question: What oath did David swear to Bathsheba?
options: Solomon your son shall reign after me
I will give you half my kingdom
questions.correctAnswer: Solomon your son shall reign after me
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:30 (ESV): "...Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place..."

questions.question: Who was Benaiah the son of?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:8 (ESV): "...and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada..."

questions.question: Upon what animal did Solomon ride to his anointing?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 1:33 (ESV): "Take with you the servants of your lord and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule..."

key_verse_text: There Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tent and anointed Solomon. Then they blew the trumpet, and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!” (ESV)
